arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python - <<'EOF'
import numpy as np, scipy.sparse as sp
import solve
A=sp.load_npz('/input/cases/d8e78b2115453c1ce7d6/A.npz').tocsr()
levels=[solve.Level(A,(128,128))]
cur=levels[-1]
n=cur.shape[0]
R=solve._restrict_matrix(n)
P=R.T.tocsr()
Ac=(R@cur.A@P).tocsr()
Ac.sort_indices()
lv=solve.Level(Ac,(n//2,n//2))
lv.P=P; lv.R=R
levels.append(lv)
print([(l.n,l.P is None) for l in levels])
print(solve.build_hierarchy.__code__.co_consts)
print(solve.build_hierarchy.__code__.co_names)
print(solve.build_hierarchy.__code__.co_varnames)
print(solve.build_hierarchy.__code__.co_code[0:0])
EOF
